• Personalità motivata con elevata competenza sociale e stile di azione imprenditoriale
• Squadre di lavoro, motivante ambiente di lavoro Contatto Per domande sulla posizione (riferimento 1266): Roger Maier Amministratore delegato di MEDAG Tel: +41 (0)62 311 46 27 Il Medical Services soH AG (MEDAG) è a capo della pratica del gruppo Herrenmatt a Däniken. descriptionByLocale.en:
Tasks Tasks
• Self-employed management of consultation hours
• First care of the general medical emergency Patients with a medical emergency
• Ensure excellent basic care
• Work with practical partners and the practice team Profile Profile
• Specialist title General internal medicine (with foreign diploma with MEBEKO recognition)
• Experience in a comparable environment
• Motivated personality with high social competence and flair for entrepreneurial action
• Collegiate teams, motivating working environment Contact For questions about the position (reference 1266): Mr Roger Maier Managing Director of MEDAG Tel: +41 (0)62 311 46 27 The Medical Services soH AG (MEDAG) is leading the group practice Herrenmatt in Däniken. It ensures basic care for the municipalities of Däniken and Gretzenbach. The offer is rounded off with specialist services in gynecology and obstetrics. The MEDAG is a subsidiary of Solothurner Spitäler AG (soH).
